# Indian Medical Course (IMC)

> India's Leading Post-Graduate Medical Education, Clinical Fellowship & Hospital Rotation Platform.

## Overview
Indian Medical Course (IMC) is an accredited medical education provider offering 150+ post-graduate clinical fellowships, PG diplomas, and advanced procedural masterclasses for medical doctors (MBBS, MD, MS, DNB, AYUSH).

- **Website**: https://indianmedicalcourse.com
- **Helpline**: +91 8295843006
- **Admissions Email**: admissions@indianmedicalcourses.com
- **Accreditation**: CPD Standards Office (United Kingdom), CME Credits
- **Hospital Rotation Network**: Apollo Hospitals, Fortis Healthcare, Max Super Speciality, Medanta The Medicity, Manipal Hospitals (50+ Tertiary Centers across India)
- **Eligibility**: MBBS / MD / MS / DNB or equivalent medical council registered practitioners (NMC / State Councils)
- **Financing**: 0% Interest EMI Tuition assistance available.

## Key Medical Fellowship Programs
1. **Fellowship in Clinical Cardiology**: 12 Months Hybrid (ICU, Cath Lab, 2D Echo, TMT, Holter).
2. **Fellowship in Critical Care Medicine**: 12 Months (Ventilator management, ECMO, arterial lines, ICU bedside).
3. **Fellowship in Laparoscopic Surgery**: 6 Months (Minimal access surgery, wet-lab simulation, OT scrub-in).
4. **Fellowship in Clinical Dermatology & Aesthetics**: 12 Months (Lasers, PRP, chemical peels, trichology).
5. **Fellowship in Fetal Medicine & Ultrasound**: 6 Months (Anomaly scans, Doppler, obstetric sonography).
6. **Fellowship in Emergency Medicine & Trauma**: 12 Months (ATLS protocols, resuscitation, triage leadership).
7. **Fellowship in Clinical Diabetology**: 6 Months (Insulin regimens, diabetic foot salvage, CGM).
